title: ADR 0029: how Ward ships as a compiled, signed, verifiable release (DEC-301)
description: DEC-301 (opum-doc, 2026-11-23): Opum ships key-holding CLIs as a compiled program, not npm under node. Records the decision in this repo as an ADR naming DEC-301, per the fleet design-authority rule. Sources: opum-doc docs/reference/distributing-opum-compiled-cli-tools.md; ADR 0001.
